evidence: The paper evaluates random forest model performance using balanced accuracy and AUC metrics across 24 bioactivity datasets and 12 molecular fingerprints. No feature importance, impurity-based importance, or variable ranking is computed or discussed. The work states: "the best-performing models that achieved test set AUC values of 0.62–0.99 have been integrated into an easy-to-use graphical user interface" and focuses entirely on which fingerprints produce the best predictive accuracy for different drug discovery targets, not on interpreting feature importance.
